question: Find the value of the expression (0.079² + 0.25² + 3.37²)/(0.0079² + 0.025² + 0.337²).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe the relation between numerator and denominator terms:

0.0079 = 0.079 ÷ 10

Every term in the denominator is 1/10th of the corresponding term in the numerator.

Since the terms are squared, the denominator becomes 1/100th of the numerator.

Expression = Numerator ÷ (Numerator ÷ 100) = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**
